summary.executiveSummaryReference: The meeting confirmed continued TF24 remediation priorities, with risk, software, contract management, subcontractors and usability still central. Alarm updates had been completed and clinically reviewed, language changes were ongoing, and in-house electrical testing would push the software workstream to the end of July. The team also reviewed subcontractor procedure updates, formative study planning, process-map responses, PMS alignment and the need to move documentation quickly because timelines were tightening.
